mu_name_from: OURS. Group 13 number 29 is free in 0.75. The name says its signature power. docs/game/jewellery.md, 'Powers'.
why_this_one: A second powered pendant, so the amulet slot has more than Fury (the user, 2026-10-16, picking it from a powered pendant to fill that gap). Its signature: attack and casting speed, +2 at +0 to +10 at +9. Up to three more powers roll at the drop; how many is its colour. Haste itself is never a further power.
profile_note: As Gem05: a small painted sheet on a made object seen close.

stats.note: Ours, on MU's jewellery row: a 1x1 piece, durability 50, every class, level asked its drop level.
stats.power: Attack and casting speed, +2 at +0 to +10 at +9.
